A compressed spring projects a ball horizontally in a vacuum chamber.
On the Earth, the ball reaches the chamber floor 4.0m in front of the spring.
An identical experiment is done on the Moon. The gravitational field strength is lower on the
Moon than on the Earth.
The experimental results on the Moon are compared with those on the Earth.
Which statement is correct?
A
The horizontal speed is greater on the Moon and the ball hits the floor 4.0m in front of the
spring.
B
The horizontal speed is greater on the Moon and the ball hits the floor more than 4.0m in
front of the spring.
C
The horizontal speed is the same on the Moon and the ball hits the floor 4.0m in front of the
spring.
D
The horizontal speed is the same on the Moon and the ball hits the floor more than 4.0m in
front of the spring.
